background.value: Clear background (plain, uncluttered) — the official document guide does not specify an exact colour

validity.value: Photo must be taken within the last six months

file_spec.value: Accepted formats: PDF, JPEG, PNG at 96 DPI. Maximum file size 512KB. Filename must use only numbers 0-9 and letters A-Z (upper/lower case), maximum 35 characters. Compressed files (e.g. zip) are not accepted. Attachment must be upright.

expression_restriction.value: Neutral facial expression with both eyes open; colour photo

glasses_policy.value: Glasses must be removed for the photo

face_visibility.value: Full face looking at the camera, well illuminated

headwear_policy.value: A hat or head covering that obscures the hair or hairline is not allowed, unless worn daily for religious reasons — in which case the full face must still be visible and the covering must not cast any shadow on the face.

expression.en: Neutral facial expression with both eyes open; colour photo.
expression.ko: 양쪽 눈을 뜬 무표정을 유지할 것; 컬러 사진이어야 한다.
expression.ja: 両目を開けた無表情を保つこと。カラー写真であること。

glasses.en: Glasses must be removed for the photo.
glasses.ja: 撮影時にはメガネを外す必要がある。

face_visibility.en: Full face looking at the camera, well illuminated.
face_visibility.ko: 얼굴 전체가 카메라를 향하고 조명이 고르게 비춰야 한다.
face_visibility.ja: 顔全体がカメラの方を向き、均一に照明が当たっていること。

headwear.en: A hat or head covering that obscures the hair or hairline is not allowed, unless worn daily for religious reasons — in which case the full face must be visible and the covering must not cast any shadow on the face.
headwear.ko: 머리카락이나 헤어라인을 가리는 모자나 머리 가리개는 허용되지 않는다. 다만 종교적 사유로 매일 착용하는 경우는 예외이며, 이때도 얼굴 전체가 보여야 하고 얼굴에 그림자가 지면 안 된다.
headwear.ja: 髪の毛や生え際を隠す帽子や頭部の覆いは許可されない。ただし宗教上の理由で日常的に着用している場合は例外とし、その場合も顔全体が見える必要があり、顔に影がかかってはならない。

db_conflicts.research_value: The official eVisa attachment/document guide (evisa.rop.gov.om) specifies only 'Clear background' with no colour named — it does not state or confirm blue specifically.

cross_verification.note_en: This record covers Oman's eVisa (evisa.rop.gov.om), a distinct Royal Oman Police service from the physical passport (see om-passport.json, left unverified). The Attach_Document_Guide page was successfully fetched directly and is the primary source for all verified fields above. It does not state an exact photo pixel size, so size/head_height remain unverified even though third-party sites commonly cite 40x60mm — that figure was not confirmed on the official document guide.
